mode: read-only source review; baseline installed scanner CLI and cached Spring 7 metadata probes used; no Gradle run
conclusion: Two concrete composed-Feign defects were reproduced against the installed pre-fix scanner. Current source contains bounded corrections for both; final-distribution validation remains with the coordinator.

findings.status: confirmed on baseline; target-only override fix present in current source
findings.summary: Composed EnableFeignClients aliases could erase an independent package setting and omit Feign CALLS.
findings.root_cause: Discovery.feignAnnotation treated value and basePackages as a replacement group. Spring Cloud OpenFeign's EnableFeignClients declares no @AliasFor between these attributes; FeignClientsRegistrar.getBasePackages reads both arrays and unions non-empty values.

code_evidence.detail: Current code removes only the overridden target at line 322, preserving the separate package attribute.
Independent meta value plus basePackages override, and paired value/basePackages override cases.

upstream_contract.detail: EnableFeignClients value documentation calls value an alias, but the annotation has no @AliasFor declaration. FeignClientsRegistrar.getBasePackages adds value and basePackages independently before selecting the importing package only when their union is empty.

baseline_reproduction.result: All 7 baseline expectations passed. paired-value-only and independent-meta-value-and-basepackages-override omit the users CALL; paired-basepackages-only retains it.

findings.status: confirmed on baseline; runtime-retention filter present in current source
findings.summary: Discovery traversed composed EnableFeignClients annotations even when Java/Spring metadata does not retain the composed annotation at runtime.
findings.root_cause: The source meta-annotation walk followed every indexed AnnotationDeclaration. SOURCE, CLASS, and default retention annotations are invisible to Spring 7 reflection and ASM AnnotationMetadata, but the source scanner still found their @EnableFeignClients meta-annotation and attributed a client call.

code_evidence.detail: Current `runtimeRetention` guard is shared by app discovery and composed annotation resolution.
`read` now applies the same guard before traversing composed meta-annotations.
Regression covers absent, CLASS and SOURCE retention negatives and a RUNTIME positive control.

spring7_probe.observed: SOURCE, CLASS and default retention return false via reflection MergedAnnotations and Spring ASM AnnotationMetadata (hasMetaAnnotation and getAnnotations); RUNTIME returns true in all three.

baseline_cli_reproduction.result: Baseline scanner incorrectly emits the users CALL for all four retention modes: absent/default, CLASS, SOURCE and RUNTIME.

reviewed_areas.evidence: Discovery.java uses source AnnotationDeclaration resolution, runtime-retention filtering, cycle detection and the same isApp predicate for discovery and library scan roots.
Service.nameEvidence uses the same isApp predicate and falls back to launcher declaration evidence for composed apps.

reviewed_areas.result: No additional blocker found in reviewed parser
reviewed_areas.evidence: Modules.java documents Maven dynamic profile/BOM and computed Gradle layout limits; those inputs are not claimed as supported.
